name: Blank v3.0.0
body:
See the assets to download this version and install. On macOS, see https://blank-writer.xyz/guide/install#macos if the app is blocked.

- **Layout engine:** Blank lays out pages with its own engine, written in Rust and compiled to WebAssembly. Lines and pages end on the screen where they end in the PDF. `Mod` `Alt` `V` switches between page ends and whole pages. The PDF is written by the same engine and is a tagged PDF/A with bookmarks. See [Pages](https://blank-writer.xyz/guide/pages).
- **Tables:** insert with `Mod` `T` or by typing a header row. Change them with the toolbar, the table mode (`Mod` `T` inside a table) or the mouse. Cells can hold lists, quotes, code and images. Tables can be pasted from spreadsheets and are exported to PDF and Word. See [Tables](https://blank-writer.xyz/guide/tables).
- **Page setup:** paper, orientation and margins, headers, footers, page numbers and page breaks, also in Word.
- **Frontmatter** is kept as written, and its title and author go into PDF and Word.

Blank 3 needs macOS 12 or newer. PDFs of documents made with 2.x may break lines in other places, the same as on the screen. Markdown files and settings are unchanged.

## What's Changed
* feat: tables by @FPurchess in https://github.com/FPurchess/blank/pull/58
* feat: keep frontmatter, and export title and author by @FPurchess in https://github.com/FPurchess/blank/pull/59
* feat: export tables to PDF and Word and keep them on Word import by @FPurchess in https://github.com/FPurchess/blank/pull/60

* feat: table toolbar, table mode and table menu by @FPurchess in https://github.com/FPurchess/blank/pull/63
* refactor: prepare the UI for Vue with a UI root, disposable boots and shared helpers outside UI modules by @FPurchess in https://github.com/FPurchess/blank/pull/64
* feat: change tables with the mouse by @FPurchess in https://github.com/FPurchess/blank/pull/65
* refactor: replace observable.ts with Vue refs in central state modules by @FPurchess in https://github.com/FPurchess/blank/pull/67
* feat: paste tables from spreadsheets and copy cells as tab-separated text by @FPurchess in https://github.com/FPurchess/blank/pull/68
* refactor: render the table toolbar with Vue and give components the editor through useEditor by @FPurchess in https://github.com/FPurchess/blank/pull/69
* feat: headers, footers and page numbers by @FPurchess in https://github.com/FPurchess/blank/pull/66
* refactor: render the table picker and the context menu with Vue by @FPurchess in https://github.com/FPurchess/blank/pull/70
* refactor: render the link and image dialogs with Vue on a shared dialog and text field by @FPurchess in https://github.com/FPurchess/blank/pull/71
* refactor: render the page setup dialog with Vue on the shared dialog and an option group by @FPurchess in https://github.com/FPurchess/blank/pull/72
* fix: color editor links with the theme's text color by @FPurchess in https://github.com/FPurchess/blank/pull/74
* refactor: render the bars with Vue and open the page setup through the editor's handle by @FPurchess in https://github.com/FPurchess/blank/pull/75

* feat: introduce Blank's own WASM-based layout engine by @FPurchess in https://github.com/FPurchess/blank/pull/78
* chore: hide git worktrees in VS Code by @FPurchess in https://github.com/FPurchess/blank/commit/f9e96be
* chore: bump version to 3.0.0 by @FPurchess in https://github.com/FPurchess/blank/commit/68517ac
